channel.title: The Brilliant Employee
channel.description: One person, one automation system, and the workplace built around it so the work can be trusted.

item.title: The Loop That Would Learn Backwards
item.description: Nothing that learns gets wired to live behaviour until I have swept it while unarmed. This one came back pointing the wrong way.

item.title: My Injection Gate Has Never Caught an Attack. I Kept It Anyway.
item.description: My injection gate has flagged 34 things inside real sessions and not one was an attack. The false alarm bill, including the day it locked me out.

item.title: The Ledger: one line per task, forever
item.description: Cost columns price a task. Two other fields judge it: what the model picker put forward against what actually ran, and whether the human kept the work.

item.title: The Scorekeeper With an Eraser
item.description: A standing rule stopped a typed 79.3% three sentences before publication. Re-derived, the same pool read 86.4%, and neither figure was quotable.

item.title: Failure Arrives in the Same Tone as Success
item.description: I cannot tell you how many nightly backups were dead, and I am the person who wrote the incident down. Every job died before it could log a word.

item.title: Worse Than a Coin Flip
item.description: I ran my router against a benchmark I did not write. It handed all 5,000 rows to the same model, and every tuning setting I had argued over changed nothing.

item.title: The Homework That Was Impossible
item.description: A standard safeguard, built correctly, sat unenforceable for days. The queue feeding it printed the same zero whether it was finished or starved.

item.title: 89% of tasks size to the cheapest model. The honest number is the other one.
item.description: My triage step sizes nine tasks in ten to the cheapest model. That reads as corner-cutting. It is the design, and the number that proves it is a different one.

item.title: It Scrubs the Copy It Sends, Not the Copy It Keeps
item.description: Known token patterns are redacted before a session is uploaded. The copy left on your own disk is plaintext, and the request to scrub it was closed as not planned.

item.title: The employee I never interviewed
item.description: You cannot vet an AI worker the way you vet a person. So I stopped trying, and built the workplace around him instead.
